description: Existing saved cart of the declared registered user with at least one active product, the user owning at least N saved carts. Moving it to the cart copies it; the saved cart stays. KB: Create an Order from the Storefront (Option G: Saved Cart); Shopping Cart.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the saved cart: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username

minSavedCarts.description: Saved carts the user must own (2 or more for the Saved Carts scroller)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
